S0792.reason: OverCat is the feline archenemy of Underdog, as the name suggests superiority over dogs.

S0320.reason: In 1950, U.S. GDP per capita adjusted for inflation and PPP was around $15,000 in 2011 dollars.

S0229.reason: Primary refuse is discarded at the location of use (activity area), while secondary refuse is moved to a separate disposal area (burial).

S1167.reason: Five kilograms of feathers has the greatest mass, so it weighs the most on the moon.

S0525.reason: The theme song mentions Herbert Hoover, who was president during the Great Depression.
